issuer: the Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)
note: The DPS fee page (read 2026-10-30; fees include a $1 administrative fee not charged by mail) gives a new licence for ages 18 to 84 at $33, expiring after eight years, and a licence issued under 18 at $16, expiring on the 18th birthday (the provisional licence), so a full licence is kept from 18. An ID card, 59 and younger, is $16 and expires after six years. The page states no youngest age for an ID card, so the card has none. Not held: the 85-and-older two-year licence, the $6 card from 60, limited-term licences for temporary visitors.

sources.title: Texas DPS, Driver License Fees
sources.said: Under 18: new $16 Expires on your 18th birthday ... Age 18 to 84: new $33 Expires after eight years (on your birthday) ... Age 59 and younger: new $16 Expires after six years (on your birthday)
